name: cardiac_geometry_refinement_v3
lambda_selection: minimum validation full residual subject to component RMSE at most 10% above matched data-only
checkpoint_selection: validation scaled data MSE plus lambda times full or specified-region residual loss; all32 validation loads
physics_schedule: four training cases sampled without replacement per update, step/seed-derived random draws across geometries
residual_partition: all = interior DOF contribution + natural-boundary DOF contribution, both normalized by total DOF count; includes full assembled weak form, not zero external traction
scope: affine numerical shape distribution, startup only; separate from passive full trajectory
backend: MPS float32 analytic Piola residual, exact analytic stress with autodiff tangent
backend_gate: physics_backend.json: force and gradient relative error below1%; float64 analytic tangent also checked against trusted FE
final_validation: trusted float64 assembly for lambda selection and final checkpoint reporting
supersedes: additional matched refinement after v2; v2 results retained
protocol: matched refinement from each seed shared data-trained checkpoint; random mixed-geometry physics batches; original training20/validation8 only
lambda_grid_reason: training-only median per-case parameter-gradient norm ratio at shared data-trained seed11 warm start, rounded to decade
final_assessment: new independent confirmation cohort; previous v2 results retained, no calibration/test outcome used for model selection
